key_insight: OptScientist discovers compact symbolic optimization laws that explain observed behavior as the outcome of an underlying optimization problem.
engineering_relevance: The framework could help engineers infer interpretable objectives behind observed system behavior rather than fit input-output equations alone.
method: Learn an optimization-based representation of data, then extract its symbolic form.
Use an LLM agent to integrate scientific priors, discover candidate laws, and abstract mechanisms.
Suggest new data to collect for further discovery.
evidence_signal: On the 99-problem OptFeynman benchmark, OptScientist recovers over 80% of ground-truth laws; on risky choice and monetary policy, it reports competitive held-out prediction with few parameters.
watch_item: Predictive accuracy alone does not establish that a discovered objective is the true underlying mechanism; independent validation remains important.
paper_title: OptScientist: Automated Discovery of Optimization Laws
